faultInjection.note: The first failure in each case is deliberately injected into known-good gold SQL; the repair is done by the real correction agent against the real validator/database error.

runs.injected: SELECT p.name_value, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM order_items_summary oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
runs.diagnosis: The query referenced a non‑existent table "order_items_summary". The correct table for line items is "order_items".

runs.injected: SELECT a.city, ROUND_HALF_EVEN(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customer_addresses a ON a.address_id = o.shipping_address_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') GROUP BY a.city ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
runs.diagnosis: The query used the non‑standard function ROUND_HALF_EVEN, which is not allowed in the permitted function set. Replacing it with the standard ROUND function resolves the error.

runs.injected: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount)::float8, 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT c.name AS category,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE))
         - SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '2 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'))
         / NULLIF(SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '2 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'), 0), 2) AS growth_pct
     FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '2 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
runs.diagnosis: The SELECT references c.name without a GROUP BY clause, causing a 42803 error.

runs.injected: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE AND o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) t
runs.diagnosis: The subquery had an extraneous 'AND' in the WHERE clause, causing a syntax error. Additionally, the business rule requires counting distinct order IDs, not all rows.

runs.injected: SELECT p.name_value, w.name AS warehouse, wi.quantity_on_hand, wi.reorder_level FROM warehouse_inventory wi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = wi.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = wi.warehouse_id WHERE wi.quantity_on_hand <= wi.reorder_level ORDER BY wi.quantity_on_hand ASC
runs.diagnosis: The query referenced a non‑existent column "name_value" on the products table and joined to a non‑existent warehouses table.

runs.injected: SELECT s.name AS supplier, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM suppliers_summary s JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, s.name LIMIT 1
runs.diagnosis: The query referenced a non‑existent table `suppliers_summary`. The correct table to use is `suppliers`.

runs.injected: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date)::date AS month, ROUND_HALF_EVEN(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '6 month' AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
runs.diagnosis: The query used the non‑standard function ROUND_HALF_EVEN, which is forbidden. Replace it with the standard ROUND function.

runs.injected: SELECT pr.code, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::float8, 2) AS revenue FROM promotions pr JOIN orders o ON o.promotion_id = pr.promotion_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered') GROUP BY pr.promotion_id, pr.code ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
runs.diagnosis: The ROUND function was called with a double precision value and an integer precision argument, which PostgreSQL does not support. The SUM of line_total is numeric, so casting to float8 caused the error.
